metaTitle: Custom Acrylic Awards Recognition | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom acrylic awards recognition for your team. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing on clear acrylic plaques and trophies.
introHtml: Acrylic awards recognition pieces offer a sleek, modern look that stands out on any desk or trophy shelf. The transparent material creates a floating effect for your logo or message, making it ideal for corporate achievement programs and annual employee milestones. Unlike glass, acrylic is shatter-resistant and lightweight, reducing shipping costs for bulk orders. Whether you need engraved crescent plaques or layered logo inserts, acrylic accepts laser engraving and full-color UV printing with crisp detail.
heroAltText: Custom acrylic awards recognition plaques with laser engraved logos and text on a clear acrylic surface
